definitions.explanation: Taking decisive action despite hesitation or fear; making a bold move.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{切|き}って⟦{告白|こくはく}した→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧。
{思|おも}い{切|き}って⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めた。
examples.english: I took the plunge and quit the company.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{切|き}って⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧みたら、⟦{案外|あんがい}→案外：01699_angai⟧⟦あっさり→あっさり：05650_assari⟧OKだった。
examples.english: When I boldly asked, they surprisingly agreed easily.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}る→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧ (to make up one's mind) → {思|おも}い{切|き}って (te-form as adverb)
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}り→思い切り：08527_omoikiri⟧ - to one's heart's content; with all one's might
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}った→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧ - bold, decisive (adjective use)

USAGE:
Implies overcoming hesitation or fear to take action. Often used when doing something one has been putting off or afraid to do.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{切|き}って⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ - to speak up boldly
- {思|おも}い{切|き}って⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧ - to take on a challenge boldly
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}った→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧ - a bold decision
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}った→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ - bold action

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - boldly
- ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧ - courageously
